scope: Additional original ZIP HDL variant and portable copies of all six provided Vivado projects. Existing archived HDL and repaired upstream package are unchanged.
portable_xpr_policy: Original XML retained except the absolute Project Path and File Path references, plus the corresponding waveform-option path. Original paths and personal archive names are omitted. FileSets, tops, generics, FPGA part and Vivado version retained; no synthesis/simulation/cache artifacts copied.

comparison.rar_variant_is_separate: The previously retained 42-file project_03 RAR variant is not substituted for this ZIP variant.
